difficulty_reason: H2: the author extends elliptic stability detection from finite elliptic characters to the cuspidal parahoric-data space, whose families can be globally infinite. The proof must preserve stability through Kottwitz-grade and compact-central-character components, extend one component to a unitary central character, and then use stable Jacquet data and proper-Levi induction to recover global stability of the original distribution. The restricted cuspidal-data condition and full central/inductive reduction are supplied; the result is not asserted for arbitrary quasi-characters.
